# Eleganote

> Eleganote is a cross-platform note-taking app for handwriting, PDFs, rich text, shapes, and audio. Notes are stored locally by default; Premium adds cloud backup and export.

## Getting started

1. Download the Android app from Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.anasraad.eleganote
2. Open Eleganote and create your first document.
3. Optional: sign in on https://eleganote.com/ or in the app (Profile → Premium) for cloud backup and Premium features.

## Product

- Name: Eleganote
- Category: Productivity / note-taking
- Platforms: Android (available), iOS and desktop (coming soon)
- Tech: Flutter, offline-first local storage (Hive), optional Firebase auth and cloud backup

## Key pages

- Home: https://eleganote.com/
- Privacy policy: https://eleganote.com/privacy.html
- Account deletion: https://eleganote.com/account-deletion.html
